content.text: OK, so to answer your question from 3 weeks ago: I’m hit-or-miss. I’ve been working on some creative things and its awesome, but I struggle with sitting at home -- there is a reason for all of that creativity and productivity and it doesn’t really jive well with physical health

Now, to ask you question(s) from today: On Wednesday, I got an e-mail from someone about the sweatshop operation. Yesterday, they sent me a copy of the e-mail. Today, I’m trying to figure out what to do with it
Like, I think it’s shitty and par for the course, but is this an “egregious” thing? Like, they still have jobs and in this time .... BUT the employees think they’re trying to furlough people cheap
Because a couple people have talked to HR and asked them if it’s voluntary, and it’s not
Yeah it’s weird

And we had a call today and Emily leaked to us that we’re probably going to try and start selling corporate sponsorship to universities. They want to make us into an agency. She was like “There’s a lot of ‘cool opportunities’ coming up so if you have the bandwidth, you will be asked to participate.”

I was like Sounds like a bunch of really “cool opportunities” for the Illitch’s to put more money in their pocket. They are exploiting their full time workers and a global pandemic for financial gain and we’re supposed to be OK with it bc we are lucky to still have jobs
Meanwhile, most of the people they asked to do this would make more on unemployment
